headline: Micron, Nvidia fall after SK Hynix plunges nearly 15% as chip sell-off deepens
detail: This directly impacts your heavy concentration in tech/chip names. The sell-off in a major Korean chip player signals broader weakness in the semiconductor sector, which is a core part of your portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming SMH (currently -13.8%, stop 540) or reducing exposure to SOXL (currently -49.65%) to mitigate further losses in the face of a deepening chip sell-off.

headline: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
detail: This headline explains why the SK Hynix plunge (and other Asian tech news) is so relevant to your US tech holdings. It means weakness overseas can quickly translate to losses in your portfolio.
rec: No direct trade action, but this reinforces the need to monitor global tech news closely as it directly impacts your concentrated portfolio.

headline: Nvidia’s potential new deal with OpenAI would revive a spooky tech-bubble habit, analyst warns
detail: This raises a red flag about potential overvaluation and speculative behavior in the tech sector. For a tech-heavy, margin-leveraged portfolio, this kind of sentiment can increase risk.
rec: No direct trade action, but this adds to the cautious outlook for tech. Be mindful of potential bubble concerns in your highly concentrated tech holdings.
